subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger-oriented WHEN wording now, or should this cleanup wait for a structured trigger metadata contract?
rationale: Current source still uses description as the prompt selection signal, while docs emphasize short descriptions and a separate open issue proposes an explicit trigger field; automation should not choose that public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial open PR as needed.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact for now and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that concise WHAT-only descriptions are intentional and close or supersede the related partial cleanup attempts.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial open PR as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on skill prompt tightening and bundled-skill authoring guidance among the likely owners.
